explication: Kibana is a browser-based interface for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing data in Elasticsearch. The broad user workflow is documented, but the sampled sources expose only selected implementation details, so the graph shows the documented product flow separately from evidenced internal calls. It includes query state and saved-query services, Discover tab state, field preview, and workflow execution/log-query services. Major product areas beyond these samples are represented at directory level; their internal connections are not inferred.
